name: Universal Pathfinder
description: Searches Geometry Dash levels by testing timed player inputs.

open-menu.name: Open Universal Pathfinder
open-menu.description: Press Left Alt during a level to open the Pathfinder menu.

search-speed.name: Search speed
search-speed.description: Controls how many game updates the solver waits after a failed branch before restarting. Higher values retry sooner.

max-depth.name: Maximum search depth
max-depth.description: Maximum number of timed input segments in one candidate route.

frame-resolution.name: Frame timing resolution
frame-resolution.description: Number of game updates in each input segment. After exhausting a coarse search, the solver halves this value down to one update.

max-attempts.name: Maximum attempts
max-attempts.description: Maximum number of full-level trials across all timing resolutions.

aggressiveness.name: Aggressiveness
aggressiveness.description: Changes which input patterns the depth-first search tries first.

save-search.name: Save search automatically
save-search.description: Save the current frontier after branch changes and resume it when Start is pressed for the same level.
